title: DEVILZ PVP PACK
description: This is a pvp texture pack with clean overlay, low-fire and special feature- glowing ores which makes gameplay better.
body:
# **DEVILZ PVP PACK**

A clean, optimized PvP texture pack built for smoother gameplay, better visibility, and a modern look. Perfect for Crystal PvP, Sword PvP, Survival, and general gameplay without changing the vanilla feel too much.
_This is packs works on every version till 1.21.11 also this pack can work with newer version too but new textures will not be added.
_
![DEVILZ TEXTURE PACK SMALL SNEAK PEAK](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f4b153ec10cfd5c70666f28c0f329f0651bd1a3.jpeg)

Credits - This pack is inspired by marlow's vanillav2 texture pack and PvP essentials texture pack, But this is refined and ahve some additional features.

✨ Features


🔥 Low Fire for better combat visibility
💎 Glowing Ores (all major ores)
⚔️ Custom PvP swords and tools
🛡️ Custom armor textures
💠 Custom Totem of Undying
🟣 Custom Ender Pearl
🧱 Full Bright
🎯 Improved PvP visuals
✨ Enhanced enchantment glint
🎆 Animated Firework Rocket
🎨 Clean GUI and inventory
🖼️ Improved item textures
⚡ Optimized for smooth performance
🎮 Vanilla-friendly design


📦 Includes
Custom blocks
Custom items
Custom armor
Custom particles
Custom shaders
Animated textures
Better PvP visuals
🎯 Best For
Crystal PvP
Sword PvP
SMPs
Lifesteal Servers
Bedwars & Practice
Survival
💻 Compatibility
Minecraft Java Edition
Multiplayer & Singleplayer
Works with most PvP/FPS optimization mods


❤️ Support

If you enjoy this pack:

⭐ Leave a follow on Modrinth
❤️ Favorite the pack
🐞 Report bugs if you find any
💡 Suggest new features for future updates

⚠️ Notes
Some resource packs may overwrite these textures if placed above this pack.
For the intended experience, keep DEVILZ PVP PACK at the top of your resource pack list.
